jobs.description:
Great allowance over your salary? Love working in logistics and got a sharp eye for detail? Looking for your next challenge at an awesome company? Look no further—this is the match you've been waiting for! Read on to discover your next job.

What we offer
- Allowance over salary!
- Saturday 150%
Sunday 200%
- Weekly payments!
- Accessible by public transport
- Super employer, work atmosphere is top priority
- 2 shifts (06:30 - 16:00 & 12:00 - 21:30)

Who you are
Are you organized, good at English, and love working in a busy team? Join our logistics team and help us build a healthier society in a fast-paced, rewarding role!

- You speak and understand English
- You can deal with being in a cold environment
- You want to work in two shifts

What will you do
As a logistics employee, you'll handle a fun mix of physical work and admin—moving, storing, and ordering goods while keeping everything organized. It's a varied role with a awesome team to share a laugh with, and working in the cold cabin occasionally is just the bonus you need to beat the summer heat!

- Work in different temperatures: Work in normal, cold, and freezer areas depending on the products.
- Check incoming goods: Match incoming items with order lists and invoices.
- Prepare and load orders: Stage products and load them onto trucks for shipment.
- Use warehouse equipment: Work with tools like RF scanners and manual or electric pallet jacks.

Where will you work
We are a global leader in genomics and precision health, dedicated to innovating the future of personalized medicine. Through our advanced DNA sequencing and array-based technologies, we empower researchers to make groundbreaking discoveries in oncology, reproductive health, and infectious diseases. Join us in our mission to create impactful, planet-healing solutions and pioneer the next generation of human health.

- World leader in DNA analysis
- Contributes to healthcare and this aims to improve overall health

Job application
Do you think

Start working as a Logistics Employee in Eindhoven and earn a gross hourly wage of €19.26. You will also have the opportunity to get a direct contract based on good performance. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Apply today!

Your tasks include:

    - Receiving, checking and processing incoming goods and related documents
    
- Picking orders and delivering materials to the production departments on time
    
- Carrying out first-line quality checks and visual inspections
    
- Performing packing and unpacking activities
    
- Replenishing missing items based on pick lists
    
- Operating a reach truck and, when required, other internal transport equipment
    
- Processing and preparing outgoing goods, parts and service shipments for dispatch

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €19.26 per hour
    
- Shift allowance when working in a two-shift schedule (20%)
    
- Travel allowance according to the client's reimbursement policy
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract based on good performance
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Varied logistics position in an international working environment
    
- Opportunities to obtain certificates and further develop your skills

    - At least one year of experience in a logistics position
    
- A valid reach truck certificate or willingness to obtain one in the near future
    
- Good command of the English language both spoken and written, because you will be communicating in this language mainly
    
- Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) or a valid EPT certificate is an advantage
    
- Availability to work 40 hours per week

Does this Logistics Employee position in Eindhoven sound like the right fit for you? Don't wait too long and apply today! After receiving your application, a Manpower recruiter will contact you as soon as possible.
